status_note: Original 38-task plan preserved; two supplemental sound tasks added. Rendered implementations and human acceptance remain separately recorded.

priorities.P0: First combined proof: source calibration, selected excerpt restoration, five-field processing, and aligned comparison.
priorities.P1: Full authored linear edition, complete clean audio, delivery, and optional soft/spill boundary extension; original-source discovery may run in parallel.
priorities.P2: Advanced independent layers, AI environment trials, and reproducible generative composition.

scope_contract: Five character fields occupy regions inside the source frame; they are not five separate screens or five independently clocked media players.
The shared room right of B05 remains separate from the fifth character field unless an authored event deliberately changes it.
P01-P05 are visual performer references. Script-character names remain unconfirmed until verified.
Shot B requires distinct calibration; unverified layouts use source pass-through.
Expression is authored independently of turn-taking; silent reactions can change a field.
Clean/restored dialogue remains separate from expressive audio layers.
The first proof retains the original dialogue timeline and uses a common source interval across A/B/C/D.
The first proof uses hard boundaries. Soft transitions and authored spill are optional GHERE-017 work after the proof, not prerequisites for it or for a hard-boundary linear edition.
Original sources remain unchanged; derivatives, estimated layers, and generated material retain provenance and verification status.
Unavailable original recordings do not block the MP4 pilot.
The complete linear edition does not depend on advanced segmentation, generated environments, generative recomposition, or interaction.

D.audio: selected clean pilot dialogue plus separately controlled pilot expressive layer

epics.title: Source evidence and pilot calibration
epics.objective: Establish usable source mappings, performed words, shot layouts, and a bounded pilot without delaying it for unavailable originals.

epics.title: Dialogue restoration and clean audio
epics.objective: Deliver a substantially clearer dialogue foundation before adding expressive sound treatments.

epics.title: Five character fields within one frame
epics.objective: Translate the sketch into independently controlled regions of the existing shared image.

epics.title: Combined proof and authored linear edition
epics.objective: Prove the audiovisual treatment on one continuous excerpt, then compose and finish a complete new edition.

epics.title: Independent bodies and responsive environments
epics.objective: Add targeted AI masks, gesture timing, depth, and generated environmental material when the composition benefits.

epics.title: Reproducible generative composition
epics.objective: Produce controlled variations from source-addressable units and explicit compositional rules.

epics.title: Interactive and installation editions
epics.objective: Make audience attention materially change the work while preserving reliable playback and a linear fallback.

tasks.title: Inventory sources and preserve provenance
tasks.rationale: The source film, script, sketch, and earlier study have different evidentiary roles. The new edition needs traceable inputs without changing the originals or silently reconciling their version dates.
acceptance_criteria: Record each available source by filename, byte identity or checksum, media properties where applicable, and availability status; record missing material as missing.
Preserve the supplied originals unchanged and identify every working proxy or derivative separately.
Keep screenplay wording, performed dialogue, source export dates, and inferred chronology distinct.
Record the existing Reception Study as an earlier experiment, without claiming it supplies restored dialogue or tracked person masks.
deliverables: Read-only source references and derivative naming convention
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Locate original audio and production recordings
tasks.rationale: Original recordings may contain recoverable clarity absent from the edited MP4. Their discovery should improve the production path without preventing an immediate MP4-based pilot.
acceptance_criteria: Search only available or subsequently supplied production locations and record what was actually examined.
Identify original camera audio, external recorder files, project timelines, or alternate takes if found; compare sample rates, channel content, duration, and candidate synchronization.
Report found, unavailable, inaccessible, and unverified sources separately; do not describe estimated separation as an original isolated microphone track.
Conclude with either usable source candidates and alignment notes or a bounded unavailable-source report; GHERE-005 through GHERE-019 continue from the MP4.
tasks.activation_condition: Run in parallel when original recordings or accessible production locations are available. Not a hard dependency of the MP4 pilot or full-edition source path.

tasks.title: Verify performed dialogue and source word anchors
tasks.rationale: The film and screenplay differ. Processing events and captions require the words actually performed, with uncertainties retained and phrase edges suitable for audio edits.
acceptance_criteria: Create a source-timed performed-dialogue transcript; distinguish manually checked passages from automatic proposals and explicitly retain unclear words.
Check the first pilot passage by listening, including word onsets, final consonants, interruptions, breaths, and any silence needed around edits.
Use performer IDs or unknown-speaker labels when attribution is uncertain; do not infer script-character names from spatial position.
Retain source time, any proxy offset, and the mapping back to the unchanged source; mark additional full-film word anchors by verification status.
deliverables: Source word and phrase cue table
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Calibrate shot layouts, performer identities, and sketch boundaries
tasks.rationale: The sketch describes five adjacent fields inside a source image, while the film contains another camera composition. Position alone cannot preserve character identity across cuts.
acceptance_criteria: Locate the unannotated source frame corresponding to the sketch and map the source aperture separately from screenshot margins, UI controls, and marker strokes.
Calibrate boundary strokes B00 through B05 into normalized source-frame coordinates, delimiting F01 through F05; retain uncertainty until source registration is checked.
Keep the room to the right of B05 as shared background outside the five character fields, with any other uncovered source area also accounted for.
Use stable visual performer IDs P01 through P05; leave script-character names unconfirmed until supported by evidence.
Calibrate the alternate shot B independently. For any unverified layout, explicitly use source pass-through rather than applying shot A coordinates.
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Select the pilot and representative audio benchmark excerpts
tasks.rationale: A bounded, continuous comparison makes improvement measurable and keeps the first proof independent of later world generation or interactive delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluate source 85.133-107.167 seconds, approximately 22.034 seconds, as the provisional first proof; confirm or adjust the range after listening and checking word edges.
Keep the selected pilot in original dialogue order and document exact frame/sample boundaries, any camera cut, and the relevant region layouts.
Choose additional short audio benchmarks for materially different defects or speakers when the pilot alone does not represent them.

Identify speaking and visible listening/reaction opportunities without inventing emotional states; define A source/source, B source/clean, C fields/clean, and D fields/clean plus expressive as aligned comparison conditions.
deliverables: Pilot excerpt selection and timing record
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Listen and build an audio defect map
tasks.rationale: Substantial restoration should target observed defects. Automated metrics and a transcript cannot establish intelligibility, timbre, or room problems by themselves.
acceptance_criteria: Listen to the pilot and benchmark excerpts and map observed noise, reverberation, clipping, inconsistent level, masking, and intelligibility defects by source interval.
Inspect available channels before summing them and record whether they contain useful differences or merely similar mixed material.
Separate observed listening findings from measured properties and hypotheses requiring a treatment test.
Define the material improvement sought on each benchmark, including consonant clarity, continuity, voice character, and tolerable residual ambience.
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Render restoration candidates and level-match comparisons
tasks.rationale: A louder export can sound superficially better. Competing repair chains need comparable playback levels and preserved source timing to support a meaningful selection.
acceptance_criteria: Render an untreated reference and a bounded set of treatment candidates using only methods justified by the defect map.
Record processing order, settings, model/tool identity when applicable, source selection, and any latency compensation for each candidate.
Level-match the compared excerpts and report measured levels separately from subjective judgments.
Check speech boundaries and gross artifacts before comparison; retain intact words and original source-time alignment.
Keep original dialogue and candidate outputs available independently; no synthetic replacement dialogue is introduced in this ticket.
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Compare and select the pilot restoration treatment
tasks.rationale: The pilot should proceed with a demonstrably improved dialogue foundation, with residual limitations stated rather than hidden by an expressive sound layer.
acceptance_criteria: Compare the candidates at matched loudness against the benchmark rubric and record the selection rationale.
Reject or revise treatments that lose words, alter apparent wording, introduce distracting musical/metallic residue, or damage vocal character.
Check intelligibility in a stereo listening condition and in mono; use a representative small-speaker condition when available and report actual conditions used.
Provide the selected clean pilot dialogue and its exact source-time mapping; the combined proof can now proceed without waiting for full-film restoration.
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Restore the complete dialogue track and verify synchronization
tasks.rationale: The successful excerpt treatment must be adapted to the rest of the film, whose noise, distance, or recording conditions may vary.
acceptance_criteria: Apply the selected restoration approach across the required source intervals, varying it only where the defect map or listening warrants.
Retain a clean dialogue track separate from expressive delays, panning, repetition, and environmental sound design.
Check the beginning, end, shot transitions, and selected speech anchors for processing latency or cumulative drift.
Document any source replacement found through GHERE-002 and its synchronization if such a source is actually used; unavailable originals do not prevent processing the MP4.
Identify remaining irreparable or uncertain passages for conditional consideration under GHERE-011.
deliverables: Full-film restoration recipe and sync report
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Qualify speaker layers and preserve usable ambience
tasks.rationale: Per-character audio processing may need speaker-focused layers, but the supplied mixed soundtrack does not establish isolated recordings. Layer quality and provenance must remain explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Assess whether source recordings, careful edits, or estimated separation can provide usable speaker-focused control for the required passages.
Label outputs as original isolated sources, estimated separations, or edited mixed passages as appropriate; retain leakage and uncertainty notes.
Check overlaps, breaths, room continuity, and any separation artifacts at the intended mix level.
Create a usable ambience reference where recoverable; do not describe a generated or heavily reconstructed layer as untouched room sound.
If reliable separation is unavailable, provide a documented mixed-dialogue routing fallback that still supports the authored edition.
deliverables: Usable speaker-focused layers or documented mix fallback
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Evaluate alternatives for irreparable essential lines
tasks.rationale: A few damaged lines may require a specific artistic decision. This branch should remain conditional and should not silently substitute synthetic or newly performed speech.
acceptance_criteria: Activate only for an identified passage whose remaining damage materially obstructs the intended work.
Compare available original takes, alternate edits, retained imperfection with readable text support, and separately proposed rerecording or reconstruction options.
Identify any option that changes the recorded performance or introduces new/generated audio, and retain that distinction in the source record.
Record the author-selected treatment and synchronize any adopted replacement; no option is represented as already selected by this plan.
If the branch is necessary to satisfy the edition intelligibility requirement, add its resolution to the affected release gate; otherwise it stays outside the hard dependency path.
deliverables: Conditional treatment decision and provenance record
tasks.activation_condition: Optional. Activate only when essential dialogue remains materially unusable after restoration and an alternative is required for the intended edition. No task has GHERE-011 as an unconditional dependency.

tasks.title: Complete clean-audio quality control
tasks.rationale: The full composition needs an accepted clean foundation so artistic distortion can remain deliberate and independently adjustable.
acceptance_criteria: Listen through the full clean dialogue and check words, voice consistency, breaths, transitions, noise changes, and obvious repair artifacts.
Check synchronization, channel behavior, mono compatibility, clipping/true-peak behavior, and the chosen delivery-level target; record actual measurements.
Retain a comparison reference and document any limitations still audible in the selected master.
Do not silently pass an essential unintelligible line: document the intended retained limitation or the resolved GHERE-011 alternative if that branch becomes necessary.
Mark clean-audio acceptance separately from artistic sound-design acceptance and from the later final encoded-file check.
deliverables: Accepted clean dialogue and qualified layer set
Remaining limitations and conditional gate record
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Implement a fixed-region compositor and composition schema
tasks.rationale: Five local transformations can begin as masks over one source frame. The first proof does not need five independent media players or AI person segmentation.
acceptance_criteria: Represent F01-F05 as regions within the original normalized source frame, keeping original framing and shared background intact.
Validate shot, performer, field, cue, and source references plus region ordering and bounds in a small composition schema.
Process fields through one shared source-time/rendering system; any extra frame history serves deliberate temporal effects, not separate playback clocks.
With all intensities zero, produce exact source pass-through before encoding; with an invalid or unavailable layout, fall back to the source image.

Implement hard containment for the first proof: an activated field changes only its own region, and all outside pixels match the neutral baseline before encoding. Soft transitions and authored spill are deferred to GHERE-017.
Provide an independently adjustable intensity and bounded parameters per field without assigning an unverified script-character identity.
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Define a distinct expressive grammar for each character field
tasks.rationale: The sketch supplies boundaries, while the visual language within each field still needs authored differentiation grounded in the performance.
acceptance_criteria: Assign proposed behaviors to stable performer IDs rather than unconfirmed character names, retaining the assignments as creative decisions.
Specify each field behavior by operation, expressive purpose, trigger options, intensity range, attack, duration, release, and recovery.
Allow silent listening, hesitation, resistance, or other reviewed reaction cues to drive a field; speaking alone does not determine intensity.
Treat marker colors as boundary annotations unless a separate palette is deliberately chosen; do not infer emotional types or personalities from them.
Keep the operation set small enough to distinguish the five fields and evaluate their effect in the pilot.
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Author an expression score including silent reaction
tasks.rationale: A manual score establishes what the transformation means before automatic detectors are allowed to propose events.
acceptance_criteria: Bind every enabled pilot event to a verified source interval and a stable performer/field reference.
Include at least one selected silent reaction if the source supports it, and distinguish visible evidence from the interpretation assigned to it.
Allow concurrent character states; do not restrict expression to whichever person currently speaks.
Specify intensity envelopes and recovery so changes can persist or decay intentionally rather than switching on every word.
Leave unverified illustrative cues disabled and record any scene interval deliberately held at the neutral baseline.
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Maintain shot-local temporal buffers and identity across cuts
tasks.rationale: Temporal copies and loops must not sample the wrong camera view or transfer one character state to another person occupying a similar screen position.
acceptance_criteria: Constrain delay, persistence, and loop samples to the permitted source shot unless an explicit cross-shot memory event enables another interval.
Preserve control state by performer identity across verified shot layouts while resetting or remapping visual history according to an authored cut policy.
Use shot B source pass-through until its separate calibration is valid; never reuse shot A region coordinates as an implicit substitute.
Check the pilot cut or a separate short cut diagnostic for frame contamination, identity switching, and timing jumps.
Record source-frame and output-time mappings for every temporal operation used in the proof.
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Extend verified hard boundaries with soft transitions and authored spill
tasks.rationale: Once the first hard-boundary proof succeeds, soft edges or deliberate spill can extend the expressive vocabulary where the composition benefits. They do not gate the first proof or the full hard-boundary edition.
acceptance_criteria: Retain the verified hard mode from GHERE-013 and GHERE-018 as the reference and fallback; demonstrate that enabling this extension does not change its behavior.
Soft mode uses a bounded transition width and normalized compositing weights, avoiding unintended gaps, dark seams, or double exposure.
Spill mode requires a named authored event defining recipient regions or shared background, direction, extent, and duration; it is disabled by default.
Keep sampling behavior near edges explicit so warps and temporal effects do not expose invalid image areas or unintentionally borrow another character field.
Provide short comparisons against the completed hard-boundary proof and verify weight normalization, designated spill recipients, recovery, and shared-room behavior only for the selected extension.
tasks.activation_condition: Optional extension after GHERE-019. Activate when soft transitions or authored spill are selected for the composition; the first proof and a complete hard-boundary linear edition remain independent of this task.

tasks.title: Verify neutral image, shared room, and effect containment
tasks.rationale: The room remaining to the right of B05 is part of the original image, not a sixth character or an extension automatically assigned to the nearest field.
acceptance_criteria: Account for the full source image as five fields plus residual shared background; preserve the room right of B05 and any narrow uncovered left area.
Verify zero-intensity equality before encoding and a reasonable encoded comparison that accounts for codec differences.
Activate one field at a time and confirm that hard boundaries preserve all outside pixels, with complete region/background coverage and no unintended overlap.
Keep shared room areas at source pass-through in the first proof and check hard-contained field recovery to the baseline; soft-weight and authored-spill checks belong to later GHERE-017.
Check the actual pilot at its source framing for visible seams, cropping, screenshot annotations, invalid samples, and unintended identity changes.
deliverables: Shared-room routing and mask coverage record
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Render aligned A/B/C/D combined proof from one excerpt
tasks.rationale: The first reviewable result must prove improved hearing and character-specific realities together without waiting for a full audio master or later AI systems.
acceptance_criteria: Use the selected continuous source interval, provisionally 85.133-107.167 seconds, with identical output duration and word boundaries across A/B/C/D.

Render A with source picture/source audio; B with source picture/selected clean audio; C with five fields/selected clean audio; D with five fields/clean audio plus a modest separately controllable expressive layer.
Retain original dialogue order and a common clock in all four versions. The pilot-only expressive recipe is created here; it does not wait for full-edition GHERE-021.
Use verified hard region boundaries for the first proof; soft transitions and authored spill in GHERE-017 are later optional extensions.
Include the authored silent reaction and verify containment, cut behavior, phrase intelligibility, latency compensation, and a clear neutral reference.
Provide aligned comparison files and processing settings plus a short review recording what improved, what failed, and which treatment proceeds.

acceptance_criteria: Choose the edition duration and source coverage deliberately; do not inherit the earlier study length as an obligation.
Write a continuous score covering neutral periods, character changes, collective pressure, temporal processing, room behavior, recovery, and ending.
Carry forward only operations supported by the proof or by a clearly bounded additional test; give each recurring operation a compositional purpose.
Map every used phrase, image interval, repetition, and rearrangement to source time, and document the intended intelligibility at each section.
Identify the minimum implementation work for this linear edition; do not make AI segmentation, generated environments, or audience interaction prerequisites.

acceptance_criteria: Present the artwork at the intended full-screen appearance while preserving source geometry or an explicitly selected crop policy.
Provide readable, reachable touch controls and a predictable start action for audio playback.
Handle pause/resume, orientation change, backgrounding, and interrupted playback without uncontrolled duplicate sound or desynchronized fields.
Offer reduced-motion behavior that retains the work through bounded or disabled deformation rather than merely hiding the artwork.
Test actual available target devices/browsers and report unsupported behavior honestly, including any full-screen limitation.
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Save presets, capture sessions, and provide a linear fallback
tasks.rationale: Interesting audience-produced states should be recoverable, and the work needs a practical presentation when the interactive runtime cannot be used.
acceptance_criteria: Save a preset or session record containing source/rule versions, parameters, interaction events, and timing sufficient to revisit the configuration.
Define whether capture produces a composition record, a rendered video, or both, and make that distinction visible.
Verify replay of a saved session or document any remaining nondeterministic stage.
Provide the finished linear edition or a captured session as a functional fallback with captions where applicable.
Do not claim public hosting, cross-device persistence, or recording capability unless those operations are actually implemented and checked.
tasks.activation_condition: Use the implemented production mechanisms and listed evidence; verify this task's outstanding acceptance criteria before closing.

tasks.title: Plan and calibrate an installation with spatial audio
tasks.rationale: Installation introduces a physical space, multiple listeners, and loudspeaker geometry that require venue-specific composition and testing.
acceptance_criteria: Activate when a concrete installation context exists; identify display layout, loudspeaker positions, audience movement, and the intended listening region.
Map character/shared audio and visual regions into that actual configuration, with calibration for timing, level, and intelligibility.
Check multi-listener behavior, room reflections, leakage, and recovery during long-running playback.
Provide operator start/stop, a stable fallback loop, and a documented return to a known state after failure.
Record the physical setup and calibration so results are not generalized to untested rooms or playback systems.
tasks.activation_condition: Later optional edition. Activate when a real venue, installation setup, or concrete spatial-audio target is selected; it does not gate any linear or browser edition.
